note: need Delta_a << a_c << L; "choosing the discretization such that Delta_a/a_c = 1/32 and a_c/L = 1/8 already gives accurate results for the contact area, that is, to within less than 0.1% error if the contact area is determined through a fit of the radial pressure profile" (journal p. 425)

quantity: contact area error at that resolution
note: "less than 0.1%", area from a fit of the radial pressure profile
"All five grids had the same length, slightly exceeding the contact diameter" (non-periodic MLMS, not FFT); journal p. 215
eps_0 = M_min^-3/2 (p. 9); M=1024 reached it in 34 iterations (p. 10)
proportional tangential traction added for the Mises stress
eps_r = |sqrt(A/pi) - r_H| / r_H; A = N_c a_x a_y (numerical contact area), r_H exact Hertz radius
eps_p = sum_{(i,j) in I_c} |p_ij - p_H(x_i,y_j)| / sum_{(i,j) in I_c} p_H(x_i,y_j); I_c = contact nodes
eps_s = sum_{I_g} |s(x_i,y_j,z_m) - s_H(x_i,y_j,z_m)| / sum_{I_g} s_H(x_i,y_j,z_m); z_m depth of max Mises; s_H from Sackfield & Hills; I_g = all grid nodes
"eps_r < M^-1 for all M considered"; eps_r the most sensitive. Fig. 1 points are plotted only (no table); not digitised
"on the order of M^-3/2", grows slightly faster than M^-3/2 (unexplained)
"eps_s ~ 2M^-2, and there appears to be no indication of a faster growth for larger M" (continues p. 11)
contact size changes in grid steps, so its relative error "will generally be in excess of M_min^-1"; pressure error O(M_min^-3/2)
